domains.name: Render & Delivery
domains.blurb: Text that only exists after JavaScript runs does not exist for most agents.

domains.blurb: Headings, titles and landmarks are the outline an agent extracts passages from.

domains.name: Structured Data
domains.blurb: Facts declared in JSON-LD do not have to be inferred from prose.

domains.blurb: The files an agent reads before it reads a page.

domains.name: Agent Interfaces
domains.blurb: What an agent can call once it decides to act.

checks.title: robots.txt is reachable and valid
checks.how: GET /robots.txt returns 200, text/plain, and at least one User-agent group with parseable rules.
checks.fix: Fix robots.txt at {{origin}}/robots.txt: it must return HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/plain, contain at least one "User-agent: *" group, and contain no HTML. Current evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: AI search crawlers are allowed
checks.how: Live request as OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot all return 200 (not 403/challenge/empty).
checks.fix: Unblock the AI search crawlers on {{origin}}. In robots.txt add a group with User-agent lines for OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and "Allow: /", then confirm the CDN/WAF does not challenge them. Current evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: 11/11 AI search crawlers allowed: OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, bingbot, Applebot, meta-webindexer, MistralAI-Index, Amzn-SearchBot, DuckAssistBot, YouBot

checks.title: Live AI agents can fetch a page a person asked about
checks.how: Live request as ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and Perplexity-User return 200.
checks.fix: Allow user-initiated AI agents on {{origin}}: add ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and Perplexity-User to the allowed robots group and remove any firewall rule keyed on those user agents. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Classic search engines are allowed
checks.how: Live request as Googlebot and Bingbot return 200.
checks.fix: Allow Googlebot and Bingbot for {{origin}} in robots.txt and at the edge — AI answer surfaces are fed by these indexes. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The edge does not challenge AI crawlers
checks.how: A request carrying an AI user agent gets a 200 with comparable body size to a browser request; no "cf-mitigated", JS challenge or 403.
checks.fix: Stop the CDN/WAF on {{origin}} from challenging AI crawlers: add an allow rule for the AI user agents ahead of managed bot protection, and make sure the challenge response is not being served instead of HTML. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: No blanket Disallow: / applies to everyone
checks.how: The wildcard group does not disallow the whole site, or a wildcard-by-path rule does not shadow the AI groups.
checks.fix: Remove "User-agent: * / Disallow: /" from robots.txt on {{origin}}, or scope it to private paths only (/cart, /checkout, /account, /admin). Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: wildcard group does not disallow the site

checks.title: AI bot policy is named, not inherited
checks.how: robots.txt names at least 6 known AI crawlers in explicit groups.
checks.fix: Name the AI crawlers explicitly in robots.txt for {{origin}} instead of relying on a wildcard, so each one has a deliberate policy. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Training policy is explicit
checks.how: A stated allow/block for training-only crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider) or a Content-Signal line.
checks.fix: State a training policy on {{origin}}: either name CCBot / Google-Extended / Bytespider explicitly in robots.txt, or add a Content-Signal line (search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no). Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: No CAPTCHA on primary pages
checks.how: Homepage and sampled inner pages contain no visible CAPTCHA widget or captcha JS gate on first paint.
checks.fix: Remove the visible CAPTCHA from {{url}}; agents stop at them. Keep challenges on login/contact forms only. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: No age/consent/geo wall in front of content
checks.how: Server HTML contains the real page content, not an interstitial; no IP-based redirect to another locale on first hit.
checks.fix: Serve real content from {{url}} in the server HTML and overlay any age/consent gate client-side; serve a default region at / instead of a geo redirect. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: content is not behind an interstitial

checks.title: Page is indexable
checks.how: No noindex in meta robots or X-Robots-Tag, no nofollow on the canonical.
checks.fix: Remove noindex from {{url}}: drop it from the meta robots tag and the X-Robots-Tag header. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Snippets and large image previews are allowed
checks.how: meta robots or X-Robots-Tag permits snippets (max-snippet >= 0) and max-image-preview:large.
checks.fix: On {{origin}} set "max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large" in the meta robots tag or X-Robots-Tag so assistants can quote the page. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: robots.txt does not disallow what the site advertises
checks.how: No sitemap URL, discovery file, or manifest the site publishes is disallowed for the crawler that needs it.
checks.fix: On {{origin}} make robots.txt consistent with the files you publish: allow /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml and every /.well-known/ endpoint you advertise. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Infrastructure paths are excluded from crawl budget
checks.how: /api/, /cdn-cgi/ and parameter permutations are disallowed; content and static assets are allowed.
checks.fix: On {{origin}} exclude infrastructure from crawl budget: Disallow /api/ and /cdn-cgi/, then re-Allow /static/ and your badge/sitemap paths. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Homepage content is in the raw HTML
checks.how: At least 500 characters of meaningful text and at least one H1 appear in the response body with scripts stripped.
checks.fix: Server-render the homepage of {{origin}}: ship at least 500 characters of real text and an H1 in the initial HTML response rather than after hydration (SSR/SSG, or prerender). Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: 29825 chars of text, 1 H1 in raw HTML

checks.title: Inner pages carry text without JavaScript
checks.how: Sampled inner pages each return 400+ characters of text with scripts stripped.
checks.fix: Server-render the inner pages of {{origin}} ({{evidence}}): move the primary copy into the HTML response for each template, not only the homepage.
checks.evidence: 2/2 sampled inner pages carry 400+ chars without JS

checks.title: Canonical URL answers 200 within one hop
checks.how: The scanned URL returns 200 after at most one redirect.
checks.fix: Collapse redirects on {{url}}: aim for 0-1 hops to the final 200 URL and link the final URL directly. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Unknown URLs return a real 404
checks.how: A made-up path returns 404 (not 200, not a soft 404 page).
checks.fix: Return a real 404 status for unknown paths on {{origin}} instead of a 200 soft-404 page, and include links to real pages in the body. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Correct Content-Type and charset
checks.how: text/html; charset=utf-8 on HTML, text/plain for llms.txt and robots.txt.
checks.fix: Set correct Content-Type headers on {{origin}}: text/html; charset=utf-8 for pages, text/plain; charset=utf-8 for robots.txt, llms.txt and markdown mirrors. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Response is fast enough for an agent timeout
checks.how: Time to first byte under 800 ms and full body under 3 s from a cold request.
checks.fix: Speed up the server response for {{url}}: TTFB should land under 800 ms. Cache the HTML at the edge, and remove synchronous calls from the render path. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Page weight is reasonable
checks.how: HTML document under 1 MB and no unbounded inline payloads.
checks.fix: Reduce the HTML payload of {{url}} to under 1 MB: move large inline JSON/state blobs and base64 images out of the document. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Text responses are compressed
checks.how: br or gzip accepted and returned for HTML/JSON.
checks.fix: Enable Brotli/gzip compression for HTML and JSON on {{origin}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Text-to-markup ratio is workable
checks.how: Visible text / HTML bytes above 5% after stripping scripts, styles, nav and footer.
checks.fix: Raise the text-to-markup ratio on {{url}} to at least 5%: trim wrapper divs and inline styles, and put the copy in plain elements. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Primary content does not depend on client rendering
checks.how: The page text is identical with JavaScript disabled at the HTML level (no empty root node).
checks.fix: Remove the JavaScript dependency for primary content on {{origin}}: the raw response must not be an empty mount node. Render on the server and hydrate. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: document has content before scripts run

checks.title: Document is parseable without executing scripts
checks.how: No document.write after load, no content injected above the fold on a timer.
checks.fix: On {{origin}} stop injecting above-the-fold content after load (no document.write, no delayed hero render), so a non-executing parser sees the final DOM. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Title is unique and the right length
checks.how: A <title> of 15-65 characters that names the page, not just the brand.
checks.fix: Rewrite the <title> of {{url}} to 15-65 characters that names the specific page, brand last. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Meta description is present and useful
checks.how: Meta description 50-170 characters, unique per page.
checks.fix: Write a 50-170 character meta description for {{url}} that states what the page answers. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Exactly one H1 states the page subject
checks.how: One H1 in the document, not empty, distinct from the title tag.
checks.fix: Ensure exactly one non-empty H1 on {{url}} that states the page subject; demote extra H1s to H2. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Headings are sequential and descriptive
checks.how: No skipped levels; H2s describe the section, not "Section 1".
checks.fix: Fix the heading outline on {{url}}: no skipped levels (H2 to H4), and make each H2 describe its section. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Canonical points at itself
checks.how: A rel=canonical link to the URL being served (or the deliberate canonical target).
checks.fix: Add a self-referencing rel=canonical to {{url}} that matches the URL actually served (https, final host, no tracking params). Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Language is declared and well-formed
checks.how: html lang is a valid BCP-47 tag (e.g. en, en-US).
checks.fix: Set a valid BCP-47 lang attribute on <html> for {{origin}} (for example lang="en-US"). Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Open Graph title, description and image
checks.how: og:title, og:description and og:image (1200x630) present.
checks.fix: Add Open Graph tags to {{url}}: og:title, og:description, og:image (1200x630 absolute URL), og:url, og:type. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: og:title yes, og:description yes, og:image yes

checks.title: Card metadata for chat previews
checks.how: twitter:card plus title/description/image.
checks.fix: Add twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description and twitter:image to {{url}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Viewport is set and pinch-zoom is not disabled
checks.how: A viewport meta without user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
checks.fix: Set <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> on {{origin}} and remove user-scalable=no / maximum-scale=1. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Content is separated by landmarks
checks.how: main or article element, plus nav/header/footer.
checks.fix: Wrap the primary copy of {{url}} in <main> or <article> and keep nav/header/footer outside it, so a parser can isolate the content. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Controls expose accessible names
checks.how: Every button, link and input has text, aria-label or an associated label.
checks.fix: Give every interactive control on {{url}} an accessible name: visible text, aria-label, or a <label for>. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Link text describes the destination
checks.how: No "click here" / "read more" as the only link text on sampled pages.
checks.fix: Replace generic link text on {{url}} ("click here", "read more") with the destination name. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Alternate language versions are declared
checks.how: hreflang plus x-default when more than one locale is served.
checks.fix: Declare hreflang alternates plus x-default on {{origin}} for each locale you serve. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Images carry text alternatives
checks.how: All content images have alt, decorative images have alt="".
checks.fix: Add alt text to content images on {{url}} and alt="" to decorative ones. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: JSON-LD structured data is present
checks.how: At least one application/ld+json block with a parseable @context.
checks.fix: Add a JSON-LD block to {{url}} with @context https://schema.org and a @type that matches the page. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: 1/1 JSON-LD block(s) parse; types: Organization, ImageObject, WebSite, SearchAction, EntryPoint, WebPage

checks.title: Declared type matches the page
checks.how: WebPage/Organization for a homepage; Article, Product, Service, FAQPage, HowTo as appropriate.
checks.fix: Declare the correct schema type on {{url}} ({{evidence}}) — Product for a product page, Article for editorial, Service for a service, FAQPage when the page answers questions.
checks.evidence: declared: Organization, ImageObject, WebSite, SearchAction, EntryPoint, WebPage

checks.title: Publisher entity is declared and linked
checks.how: Organization or Person node with name, url, logo, and sameAs to the profiles the brand owns.
checks.fix: Add an Organization (or Person) JSON-LD node on {{origin}} with name, url, logo, and sameAs links to the profiles the brand actually owns. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Published and modified dates are declared
checks.how: datePublished and dateModified in the page schema.
checks.fix: Add datePublished and dateModified to the schema on {{url}}, kept in sync with the visible date. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: BreadcrumbList declares the page position
checks.how: A BreadcrumbList with name+item for each level.
checks.fix: Add a BreadcrumbList to {{url}} whose items match the visible breadcrumb. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Product facts are in machine-readable form
checks.how: Product schema with name, image, offers.price, priceCurrency and availability.
checks.fix: Add Product JSON-LD to {{url}} with name, image, sku, offers.price, offers.priceCurrency, offers.availability and brand. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: no Product node (not a product page)

checks.title: Variants are modelled
checks.how: hasVariant / ProductGroup entries or an ItemList of variants with size/colour identifiers.
checks.fix: Model the variants of {{url}} in schema with hasVariant (or a ProductGroup with variesBy) including each size/colour and its own offer. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Shipping and return terms are in structured data
checks.how: shippingDetails and hasMerchantReturnPolicy on the offer.
checks.fix: Add shippingDetails (OfferShippingDetails) and hasMerchantReturnPolicy to the offers on {{url}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Answer-shaped extras where the page answers questions
checks.how: FAQPage / HowTo / Question blocks when the page contains those answers.
checks.fix: Mark the question-and-answer pairs on {{url}} as FAQPage, and any ordered steps as HowTo, matching the visible copy. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Structured data matches visible content
checks.how: No price/name mismatch between JSON-LD and the rendered HTML.
checks.fix: Reconcile JSON-LD with the visible page on {{url}}: {{evidence}} — the declared values must equal what a human sees.

checks.title: Ratings or reviews are declared, if real
checks.how: AggregateRating / Review present only where genuinely shown.
checks.fix: If reviews are genuinely shown on {{url}}, declare AggregateRating with reviewCount and the individual Review nodes; otherwise leave them out. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Structured data validates
checks.how: No parse errors, no missing required properties for the declared type.
checks.fix: Fix the JSON-LD validation errors on {{url}}: {{evidence}}. Every block must parse and carry the required properties for its type.

checks.title: A sitemap is declared and lists live URLs
checks.how: Sitemap referenced in robots.txt, returns XML, entries return 200.
checks.fix: Publish a sitemap index on {{origin}}, reference it from robots.txt, and list only 200-status canonical URLs. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: declared in robots, 3 URLs in first sitemap

checks.title: Sitemap entries carry real lastmod
checks.how: lastmod present and not identical for every URL unless that is true.
checks.fix: Add truthful <lastmod> values to the sitemap on {{origin}} from real content timestamps. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Sitemaps are split by content type
checks.how: A sitemap index with child sitemaps for pages, products, posts.
checks.fix: Split the sitemap on {{origin}} into an index plus child sitemaps per content type (pages, products, posts, images). Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: /llms.txt exists and is served as text
checks.how: 200 at /llms.txt (or /.well-known/llms.txt) with text/plain and a non-empty body.
checks.fix: Publish /llms.txt on {{origin}} as text/plain: a single H1, a one-line blockquote summary, then H2 sections of [name](url) links to the pages that answer the most common questions. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: llms.txt follows the published format
checks.how: H1 first, blockquote summary, H2 sections, links in [name](url) form, optional ## Optional section.
checks.fix: Restructure /llms.txt on {{origin}} to the published format: H1, blockquote summary under it, H2 sections whose bullets are [name](url) with optional ": note" suffixes, and a ## Optional section for secondary links. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: H1 true, blockquote true, 14 H2, 93 links

checks.title: /llms-full.txt offers one-request ingestion
checks.how: A single-document variant exists.
checks.fix: Publish /llms-full.txt on {{origin}} concatenating the primary content of the site in Markdown for one-request ingestion, and link it from /llms.txt. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A Markdown mirror of the page exists
checks.how: /<path>.md or /<path>/index.md returns text/markdown.
checks.fix: Publish a Markdown mirror for each page on {{origin}}: serve /<path>.md with Content-Type text/markdown and the same content as the HTML. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Content negotiation returns Markdown on request
checks.how: Accept: text/markdown yields text/markdown, with Vary: Accept.
checks.fix: Support Accept: text/markdown on {{origin}}: return the Markdown mirror with Content-Type text/markdown and add Vary: Accept so caches stay separate. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: Accept: text/markdown → text/markdown; charset=utf-8, Vary: Accept

checks.title: HTML advertises its Markdown twin
checks.how: <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="...">.
checks.fix: Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="/<path>.md"> to the head of {{url}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: HTTP Link headers point at machine resources
checks.how: Link: <...>; rel="describedby"/"alternate"/"api-catalog" on page responses.
checks.fix: Add Link response headers on {{origin}} pointing at its machine-readable resources: rel="describedby" to /llms.txt, rel="api-catalog" to /.well-known/api-catalog, rel="alternate" to the Markdown mirror. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: DNS advertises agent endpoints
checks.how: A discovery TXT/HTTPS record (e.g. _agents or _index._agents) resolves.
checks.fix: Publish a DNS discovery record for {{origin}} (a TXT record listing the agent endpoints the site exposes) so an agent learns the surface before fetching a page. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A skill file tells coding agents how to work with the site
checks.how: /AGENTS.md or /.well-known/agents.md exists.
checks.fix: Publish /AGENTS.md on {{origin}} describing how a coding agent should build against or use the site: install, configuration, and worked examples. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The skill file is substantive
checks.how: Contains at least two of: install, configuration, usage examples.
checks.fix: Deepen /AGENTS.md on {{origin}} to include install steps, configuration, and at least one complete usage example. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Content usage preferences are declared
checks.how: A Content-Signal line stating search / ai-input / ai-train.
checks.fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt on {{origin}}, e.g. "Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no", so usage terms are machine-readable. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The index file advertises the agent entry points
checks.how: llms.txt or the discovery index names the MCP/API endpoints.
checks.fix: Add a section to /llms.txt on {{origin}} listing the machine interfaces an agent can call (API base, MCP endpoint, A2A card) with one line each. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The page declares the index that covers it
checks.how: rel="describedby" link element or Link header to the covering llms.txt.
checks.fix: Add a rel="describedby" link to the covering /llms.txt from every page on {{origin}} so an agent can widen from one page to the index. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Discovery files do not 404 quietly
checks.how: Every file the site advertises resolves; no advertised card points at a dead endpoint.
checks.fix: Remove or publish the advertised-but-missing discovery artefacts on {{origin}}: {{evidence}}. A card for an interface that does not exist is worse than no card.

checks.title: An OpenAPI description is published
checks.how: /openapi.json or /.well-known/openapi.json parses and declares paths.
checks.fix: Publish /openapi.json on {{origin}} (OpenAPI 3.1) describing every public endpoint, with operation summaries and example responses. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: An API catalog linkset is published
checks.how: /.well-known/api-catalog returns an RFC 9727 linkset.
checks.fix: Publish /.well-known/api-catalog on {{origin}} as an RFC 9727 linkset pointing at the API, its OpenAPI description and its docs. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Protected resources declare their authorization server
checks.how: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728) resolves.
checks.fix: Publish /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource on {{origin}} naming the resource and its authorization server, so an agent can discover how to get a token without scraping docs. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Authorization server metadata is published
checks.how: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 8414) resolves.
checks.fix: Publish /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server on {{origin}} with issuer, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint and grant types. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Permissions are scoped
checks.how: OAuth/OpenAPI declares named scopes or per-endpoint permissions rather than all-or-nothing.
checks.fix: Replace all-or-nothing credentials on {{origin}} with named scopes (for example read:catalog, write:cart) declared in the OpenAPI security scheme and the authorization-server metadata. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Agent sign-up is documented for machines
checks.how: /auth.md or a machine-readable credential section exists.
checks.fix: Publish /auth.md on {{origin}} telling an agent how to register, get a credential and revoke it, with the exact request/response shapes. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: An MCP server card describes the server
checks.how: /.well-known/mcp.json or /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json parses.
checks.fix: Publish an MCP server card at /.well-known/mcp.json on {{origin}}: name, description, transport, endpoint, and the tool list with input schemas. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The MCP card carries the fields a client needs
checks.how: Transport, endpoint, auth requirement and at least one tool with an input schema.
checks.fix: Complete the MCP server card on {{origin}}: transport, endpoint URL, auth requirement, and every tool with a declared input schema and description. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The advertised MCP endpoint answers
checks.how: The endpoint from the card responds to an initialize/tools list request.
checks.fix: Make the MCP endpoint advertised by {{origin}} actually answer: respond to initialize and tools/list at the URL in the card, and keep the card in sync with the deployed tool set. Evidence: {{evidence}}.
checks.evidence: MCP endpoint answered no endpoint in card

checks.title: An A2A agent card is published
checks.how: /.well-known/agent-card.json parses with name, capabilities, skills.
checks.fix: Publish a /.well-known/agent-card.json on {{origin}} describing the agent: name, description, capabilities, skills and endpoint. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Agent skills are indexable
checks.how: /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json lists skill documents.
checks.fix: Publish /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json on {{origin}} listing each skill document with name, description and URL. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Site actions are exposed to in-browser agents
checks.how: WebMCP tool registration is present in the page source.
checks.fix: Register the site's real actions (search, filter, add to cart) as WebMCP tools on {{origin}} so a browser agent can call them without guessing at the DOM. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: One index lists every agent interface
checks.how: An ARD / AI-catalog manifest enumerates the MCP, A2A, skills and API surfaces.
checks.fix: Publish an ARD manifest at /.well-known/ard.json on {{origin}} listing every agentic artefact with its type and URL, and advertise it with rel="ard". Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Errors are machine-readable
checks.how: Unknown API routes return JSON with a type/title/status, not an HTML error page.
checks.fix: Return RFC 9457 problem-details JSON for every error on {{origin}}, including unknown routes, so an agent can recover instead of parsing an HTML error page. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Rate limits are declared in headers
checks.how: RateLimit-* / X-RateLimit-* or Retry-After on API responses.
checks.fix: Emit RateLimit-Limit / RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset (and Retry-After on 429) from the API on {{origin}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The API is easy to call from a model
checks.how: Flat parameters, enums over free text, descriptions on every field, no nested auth dance.
checks.fix: Simplify the API surface on {{origin}} for function calling: flat named parameters, enums instead of free-text where possible, and a description on every field in the OpenAPI spec. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A developer portal is reachable from the homepage
checks.how: A link to docs/API reference from the homepage or main nav.
checks.fix: Link the developer docs from the homepage and main navigation of {{origin}} — one hop, not three. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A public API answers without a human
checks.how: At least one documented endpoint responds to an unauthenticated request.
checks.fix: Expose at least one unauthenticated read endpoint on {{origin}} that returns the site's core facts as JSON, and document it in the OpenAPI spec. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The site tells an agent when to use it
checks.how: A when-to-use / instructions block in the manifest, llms.txt or MCP card.
checks.fix: Add a when-to-use block to {{origin}} (in llms.txt, the MCP card or the agent manifest) stating what the agent is for, what it must not do, and one worked call. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Writes are retry-safe
checks.how: Idempotency-Key accepted on POST, or a documented natural key.
checks.fix: Accept an Idempotency-Key header on mutating endpoints of {{origin}} and document it, so an agent can retry without duplicating work. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Discovery lives at predictable paths
checks.how: The well-known paths used are the conventional ones, not bespoke URLs.
checks.fix: Move the machine-readable artefacts on {{origin}} to their conventional paths (/.well-known/*, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml) and keep redirects from the old ones. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Paid access is discoverable by an agent
checks.how: A 402 challenge carries the payment requirements, or pricing is machine-readable.
checks.fix: Make paid access discoverable on {{origin}}: return HTTP 402 with a machine-readable list of accepted payment options, or publish a machine-readable price list. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A commerce profile is published
checks.how: /.well-known/ucp returns a valid commerce protocol profile.
checks.fix: Publish a commerce profile at /.well-known/ucp on {{origin}} declaring the merchant, the catalogue, and the endpoints an agent may call. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The advertised commerce endpoint is live
checks.how: The endpoint in the profile responds with catalogue/cart operations.
checks.fix: Make the commerce endpoint advertised by {{origin}} answer for real: catalogue read, cart create, cart update. Register {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A cart can be handed back to a shopper
checks.how: A cart or checkout permalink an agent can send to a human.
checks.fix: Add a shareable cart/checkout permalink on {{origin}} that carries line items in the URL, so an agent can build a cart and hand the link to a person. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Machine payment is accepted
checks.how: x402 accepts array on a 402 response, or an advertised payment resource.
checks.fix: Accept machine payment on {{origin}}: answer with HTTP 402 and an x402 accepts array (asset, amount, network, payTo) on the paid resource. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Delegated payment authorization is advertised
checks.how: AP2 support declared on the agent card or commerce profile.
checks.fix: Advertise delegated payment authorization on {{origin}} (AP2 extension on the agent card or commerce profile) with the mandate shapes you accept. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A checkout protocol profile is published
checks.how: /.well-known/acp.json or equivalent.
checks.fix: Publish a checkout-protocol profile at /.well-known/acp.json on {{origin}} naming the checkout endpoint and supported payment methods. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Add-to-cart is a real labelled control
checks.how: A <button> or <input type=submit> inside a form, with an accessible name, not a div with a click handler.
checks.fix: Replace the add-to-cart div on {{url}} with a real <button type="submit"> inside a <form>, with an accessible name that includes the product. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Variant pickers are real form controls
checks.how: select/input/radiogroup elements with names and labels for each option.
checks.fix: Convert the variant pickers on {{url}} to real form controls (select or radio inputs) with a label per option, so an agent can set a value. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Search works through a GET URL
checks.how: A search form that produces a shareable ?q= URL returning results in HTML.
checks.fix: Make site search on {{origin}} work over GET with a ?q= parameter that returns results in the server HTML, so an agent can construct a search URL. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Price, stock and variants are in the HTML
checks.how: Product name, price, currency and availability in the raw HTML of the product page.
checks.fix: Put product name, price, currency and availability in the server HTML of {{url}} — not fetched client-side — with the variants listed. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A cart can be built without an account
checks.how: Cart add succeeds unauthenticated; checkout does not require login before payment.
checks.fix: Allow an unauthenticated cart on {{origin}} and do not force account creation before payment; if accounts are required by policy, say so in llms.txt with the exact steps. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Checkout terms an agent needs are documented
checks.how: Shipping, returns, tax/VAT and lead time stated in text an agent can read.
checks.fix: Document the checkout terms an agent must know on {{origin}}: shipping cost and regions, return window, tax handling, and lead time. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Policy pages are linked sitewide
checks.how: Returns, shipping, terms, privacy and contact reachable from every page.
checks.fix: Link returns, shipping, terms, privacy and contact from the footer of every page on {{origin}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A named, accountable author or publisher
checks.how: Visible author byline or declared publisher with a real identity.
checks.fix: Show a named author or accountable publisher on {{url}}, with a link to an about page that establishes who they are. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: A visible publish or update date
checks.how: A human-readable date on the page matching the schema dates.
checks.fix: Show a visible publish or last-updated date on {{url}} that matches dateModified in the schema. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Claims are checkable
checks.how: Outbound links to primary sources for factual claims.
checks.fix: Add outbound links to primary sources for the factual claims on {{url}} — the operator documentation, study or specification, not another summary. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: About and contact are reachable

checks.title: The organization node is complete

checks.fix: Complete the Organization schema on {{origin}} with legalName, address, contactPoint, logo and sameAs. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: The brand is named the same way everywhere

checks.title: Every page is served over HTTPS
checks.how: HTTPS with a valid certificate; http:// redirects to https://.
checks.fix: Serve {{origin}} only over HTTPS and 301 every http:// URL to https://. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: No insecure subresources
checks.how: No http:// script/img/css on an https page.
checks.fix: Rewrite the http:// subresources on {{url}} to https:// and keep the scheme relative. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Baseline security headers are set
checks.how: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and a Referrer-Policy.
checks.fix: Set Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin on {{origin}}. Evidence: {{evidence}}.

checks.title: Sampled internal links resolve
checks.how: No 404s among the internal links sampled from the page.
checks.fix: Fix the broken internal links found on {{url}}: {{evidence}}.

fixes.title: Controls expose accessible names
fixes.prompt: Give every interactive control on https://humanpeptides.fyi/ an accessible name: visible text, aria-label, or a <label for>. Evidence: 3 control(s) without an obvious name.

fixes.title: Images carry text alternatives
fixes.prompt: Add alt text to content images on https://humanpeptides.fyi/ and alt="" to decorative ones. Evidence: 1/2 images without alt.

fixes.title: A Markdown mirror of the page exists
fixes.prompt: Publish a Markdown mirror for each page on https://humanpeptides.fyi: serve /<path>.md with Content-Type text/markdown and the same content as the HTML. Evidence: https://humanpeptides.fyi.md → HTTP 0.

fixes.title: HTTP Link headers point at machine resources
